meta_title: matrixhawk® — Versatile, Trusted, Open Autopilot Documentation
meta_description: Documentation for the matrixhawk® autopilot platform, based on ArduPilot: multicopters, planes, rovers, submarines, blimps and antenna trackers. Open source, community driven.
hero_title: One autopilot platform for every vehicle you build
hero_sub: matrixhawk® documentation covers the full ArduPilot-based stack: multicopters, fixed wings, ground vehicles, boats, submarines, blimps and antenna trackers — from first flight to advanced tuning.
vehicles_sub: Each vehicle has a complete manual: hardware selection, assembly, calibration, flight modes, tuning and troubleshooting.
card_copter: Multicopters and traditional helicopters — the most complete guide, from first hover to autonomous missions.
card_plane: Fixed-wing aircraft including QuadPlane VTOL: takeoff, cruise, autoland and everything in between.
card_rover: Ground vehicles and boats: steering, skid-steer, sailboats and autonomous navigation.
card_sub: Underwater ROVs and AUVs, powering BlueROV2 and research submarines worldwide.
card_blimp: Lighter-than-air vehicles with servo-driven flapping fins — the newest vehicle class.
card_tracker: Point your ground antenna at the vehicle automatically for maximum telemetry range.
stat_translated: of the wiki available in Chinese
tool_mp: The full-featured Windows ground station: setup, calibration, mission planning and log analysis.
tool_ap2: Cross-platform ground station for Windows, macOS and Linux.
tool_mav: The scriptable command-line ground station for developers and power users.
tool_dev: Build the code, add features, understand the architecture and join the dev team.
